Verified live: /geo/search for Bengaluru, Chandigarh, Mawlynnong (village, East Khasi Hills), Hampi, Bastar, MG Road Bengaluru, Dharavi, PIN 560034/793110 (india_post source, post offices) all inside India with sources+attribution; /geo/place osm_n3178190161 -> East Khasi Hills; pin_ post-office refine; /geo/pincode 560034 ok, 000000 -> 400; /geo/reverse exact keeps coords (pin_ loc_id), outside India -> 400; /geo/route BLR-Chennai osrm 326 km via NH75/NH48 toll 343, rural 72 km, 3-point route ok, invalid -> 400; /geo/nearby Photon fallback ok; /geo/status, admin sync (ok, ~27 s) + report, passenger 403; legacy /locations/search|osm|reverse, /route/estimate ok; trip publish stores route (GET /trips/{id}.route, route_via, toll_estimate, route_line hidden); along-route match Vellore->Chennai = along_route, reverse direction not matched, direct match works, demo trip search (Chennai->Puducherry) works. Frontend (390x844): location modal autocomplete (village + PIN + post office), selection sets field, attribution + 'Map data updated' footer, per-result map preview, Choose on map (India view) -> tap -> reverse-geocoded place -> Confirm sets field, OSM tiles load in iframe (20/20 200), Offer tab route map + 'Via NH75, NH48' + tolls auto-filled 343 + pickup nearby chips (tap fills pickup) + publish -> trip detail with trip-route-map, RideCard along-route badge 'Passes your pickup (5.8 km)', admin Map database card + sync button, /add-place pin-map. No page errors. No deprecated Expo packages found.

critical.issue: Alias/old-name searches bury the curated city: 'Bangalore' -> Bengaluru at #10 (top hit is a 'Bangalore' shop/landmark in Kasaragod, Kerala), 'Bombay' -> Mumbai #9 (top two 'bombay' landmarks in Kerala), 'Mysore' -> Mysuru #8 (top: landmark in Andhra Pradesh), 'Calcutta' -> Kolkata #9, 'Madras' -> Chennai not top 3. Regression: tests/test_travoo_api.py::TestLocations::test_bengaluru_aliases[Bangalore] now fails. RCA: geo.py search().score() computes exact/prefix only on x['name'] (aliases ignored) and uses 'curated' only as the last tiebreaker, so any OSM POI whose name equals the query outranks the curated city. Fix: treat a match on aliases/search_terms as exact, and rank by (exact, curated/city-type, TYPE_RANK) so travoo/community places and city/town/village beat landmarks/shops.

500 Internal Server Error when origin and destination resolve to the same/near-identical point (e.g. curated city vs exact map pin at same spot, or different loc_ids same coords). OSRM returns geometry with 2 identical vertices -> route_line LineString invalid -> Mongo 2dsphere index rejects insert (BulkWriteError 16755 'GeoJSON LineString must have at least 2 vertices'). RCA: server.py build_trip() stores route_line without de-duplicating consecutive coords / validating >=2 distinct vertices, and create_trip has no minimum distance check. Fix: drop consecutive duplicate coords, omit route_line if <2 distinct points, and reject trips < ~2 km with 400.

minor.issue: Photon fallback (Overpass blocked from pod) uses text queries 'railway station'/'bus stand'/'bus stop' so stations not named that way are missed: Chennai centre (13.0827,80.2707) returns only 3 bus stops 2.6-5.8 km away (one named just 'Bus stop'), no Chennai Central (~0.5 km) / Egmore / CMBT. Suggest Photon /reverse?lat&lon&osm_tag=railway:station&radius=..&limit=.. per tag, and drop unnamed generic 'Bus stop'.

Sync runs synchronously inside the HTTP request (~27 s observed with tiny dataset; Nominatim 1.1 s/call for up to 10 lookup batches + 25 curated verifies + 20 PIN refreshes could exceed ingress timeout ~60 s). Run in background (asyncio task) and return {status:'started'}, UI polls /geo/status.

Breaker opens only 60 s; since Overpass is blocked from the pod, every minute one nearby request waits ~7 s on a dead mirror before Photon fallback. Consider longer open period (e.g. 30 min) for overpass.
Dedupe misses duplicates: 'Bastar' returns two identical 'Bastar' district rows; 'bombay' landmark twice. Many Photon rows have empty district until /geo/place enrichment.

Demo seeded trips are mostly dated in the past (Nov 6-7) yet status 'scheduled'; BLR->Chennai demo trips no longer appear (only TEST trips from earlier iterations). Pre-existing, consider rolling demo dates forward on startup.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py build_trip(): route_line stored without geometry validation -> 2dsphere insert failure surfaces as uncaught 500.
geo.py search(): score ignores aliases; curated priority is last tiebreaker.

geo.py Provider: single global lock per provider serialises all Nominatim calls at 1.1 s -> concurrent PIN/place lookups queue linearly; fine for low traffic, also limits multiply if multiple uvicorn workers.
geo.py run_sync step 4 deletes duplicate locations docs (merge) - safe for trips (snapshots) but ensure nothing else references loc_id by FK.
geo.py online_search cache key uses 'if lat' truthiness (lat=0 edge, harmless in India). legacy /locations/search limit lacks ge=1.
server.py is 1745 lines (>700) - should be split into modules.
